structure: CSharp evaluates Box operands before selecting canonical size/alignment, materializes and stores the complete value, and drops nested owned fields before freeing the box. Native uses canonical first type, aggregateValueIndex and writeValue in emitBoxIntrinsic. Existing shared writeLoadedValue distinguishes already-loaded readonly values from pointer ABI operands.
branches: Arena CSharp and Native both guard signed sizes/alignment/padding/end bounds, select max(doubled,end), copy used bytes before freeing old data, and update authoritative handle fields. Native uses shared raw runtime helpers to keep nested caller CFG stable. Box readonly scalar/nominal operands are a source-observed risk: generic writeValue preserves pointer ABI while CSharp reads the referent.
logic: Compare allocation, owned/move/readonly result, primitive/nested drop and original8 outputs/counts. Keep original48/81 LLVM assertions as independent mandatory checks. Do not generate a new compiler until a specific source fix and current focused CSharp proof justify it.
diagnostics: Heap/target availability, copy versus owned fields and trap-before-load bounds remain existing language contracts; no expectation or time-limit change.
